findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_product" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get full product details by PID. `locale` localises the product name, currency, pricing and URL (en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP); descriptions are English for all locales." → after: "Get full product details by PID (branded pricing; plus a `wholesale` block with the unbranded/no-setup ladder where the supplier publishes bare stock). `locale` localises the product name, currency, pricing and URL (en-AU, en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP); descriptions are English for all locales."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
